title: Whole-Book V2 bounded synthesis, durable resume and provider usage reliability

commits.message: fix(whole-book): bound V2 synthesis per unit and make resume/usage durable.

user_summary: 长篇小说（542 章级别）的全书分析不再在窗口抽取完成后卡死在合成阶段；重新分析会复用上一次失败任务里已经付费成功的窗口，不再重复扣费；章节功能改为分批生成，覆盖全部章节。
technical_summary: Run 12 completed 15/15 real-provider windows and all 7 topic intermediates, then failed deterministically at overview_type with CONTEXT_UNSAFE (estimated 123368 tokens vs 120000 safe context) and was resumed 33 times with zero provider calls. Root cause: synthesis_payload_from_intermediates built one blob (all 7 topics + full 542-entry chapter catalog) that was passed unchanged to every synthesis unit, while build_token_plan estimated synthesis input as min(safe_input_capacity, max_window_input//2) so context_safe could never evaluate to NO. CHG-086 adds per-unit topic projection, a convergent payload bound derived from measured prompt overhead, and splits the unsatisfiable pacing unit (PacingResult + N ChapterFunction rows in one 4000-token response) into PacingCoreSynthesisUnit plus bounded ChapterFunctionBatchUnit batches of 40 with catalog-owned chapter identity. Also: failed runs are now valid intermediate-reuse sources (previously only completed runs, which silently re-bought 15 paid windows), copy_intermediates enforces a provider/model/snapshot pin, and provider usage rows commit immediately so a later crash rollback cannot erase already-billed calls.
acceptance_criteria: 542-chapter / 15-window production pipeline runs end to end on real runtime with fake provider transport
every synthesis unit request stays under the safe provider context at production scale
chapters.functions covers every chapter via bounded batches of 40
chapter identity comes from the catalog, never from the model
failed-run real_provider window checkpoints are reused instead of re-bought
cross-run reuse refuses to mix providers, models or snapshots
successful provider units are never requested twice on resume
provider usage ledger rows survive a background crash rollback
no deterministic semantic scaffold in a formal real_provider result
REAL PROVIDER CALLS during agent work = 0

data_compatibility.notes: Read-only forensic audit of the user DB. No schema change. Existing run 12 checkpoints remain readable and reusable.

known_out_of_scope: DeepSeek max_context_tokens=128000 in app/model_gateway/registry.py is inconsistent with observed 150k-token successful calls; deferred to a provider-capability change.
storylens.db growth (768MB in narrative_asset_versions, 719MB un-checkpointed WAL) is a separate database-governance change.
